WITH lab_with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT != 0 
         THEN CAST(l.HGB AS FLOAT) / l.HCT 
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio,
    l.WBC
  FROM Laboratory l
),
patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    lwr.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(lwr.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
    AVG(lwr.ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM lab_with_ratio lwr
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON lwr.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY lwr.ID, p.SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM patient_stats
)
SELECT 
  ps.ID,
  ps.SEX,
  ps.avg_wbc,
  ps.avg_ratio,
  ps.avg_ratio - om.mean_ratio AS diff_from_mean
FROM patient_stats ps, overall_mean om
WHERE ps.avg_ratio > om.mean_ratio
ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
